title.zh: 维尼健康（深圳）股份有限公司 — 总部

paragraphs.zh: 维尼健康（深圳）股份有限公司成立于2004年，并于2015年成功挂牌新三板，是一家专注于湿巾研发、生产与销售的专业制造商。公司长期为 GAMA Healthcare、3M、沃尔玛、全棉时代、比亚迪、MUNCHKIN、名创优品、洁柔、清风等国内外知名品牌提供联合研发及 OEM/ODM 服务。
paragraphs.en: Founded in 2004 and listed on China's NEEQ in 2015, Vinner is a professional manufacturer specializing in the R&D, manufacturing, and supply of wet wipes. We provide joint product development and OEM/ODM services for leading global and domestic brands, including GAMA Healthcare, 3M, Walmart, PurCotton, BYD, MUNCHKIN, MINISO, C&S, and Breeze.

facilitySection.imageAlt: 维尼黄冈制造基地生产车间

title.zh: 维尼健康（深圳）股份有限公司黄冈分公司 — 制造基地
title.en: Vinner (Shenzhen) Health Products Limited Huanggang Branch — Manufacturing Facility

paragraphs.zh: 维尼黄冈工厂成立于2017年，位于湖北省黄冈市，占地面积超过20,000平方米，现有员工约150人。工厂拥有4个十万级 GMP 生产车间及40条智能化生产线，最高日产能可达8个40HQ货柜，EDI纯水产能达15吨/小时。
paragraphs.en: Established in 2017, Vinner's Huanggang manufacturing facility is located in Hubei Province, covers more than 20,000 m², and employs approximately 150 people. The facility operates four Class 100,000 GMP production workshops and 40 automated production lines, with a maximum daily production capacity equivalent to eight 40HQ containers and EDI-purified water capacity of 15 tons per hour.

body.en: Disinfectant wipes for medical and infection-control settings, including alcohol-free, alcohol, hydrogen peroxide, and peracetic acid formats.

body.en: Personal cleansing and care wipes, including bathing wipes, makeup remover wipes, and baby wipes.

body.en: Environmental and surface-cleaning wipes, including shoe-cleaning, floor-cleaning, and kitchen wipes.

body.en: Industrial wiping solutions, including general-purpose industrial wipes, heavy-duty soil-removal wipes, and cleanroom wipes.
